title: botrychium lunaria f. onondagense
intro: Botrychium lunaria f. onondagense, commonly known as Onondaga grape fern, is a rare and unique species of fern within the genus Botrychium. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Onondaga grape fern are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and potential health benefits of this plant.
